# v1.5.1 更新日志

## 🛠 修复

- **下载趋势横轴逐日显示日期**：7 天视图的每根柱子下方都显示 `MM/DD`；30 天视图显示日号，并在首日与每月 1 日带上月份，不再只标注首、中、尾三天。
- **侧边栏导航不再被拖出**：长按拖动侧栏导航项不再拖出链接或半透明拖动预览，点击跳转保持不变。
- **任务详情操作更清晰**：移除详情底部“打开位置 / 打开文件”文字按钮，统一使用文件路径旁的图标按钮；打开文件改用文档图标，两个图标顺序与下载完成页一致。
- **完成页移除批量打开**：批量操作栏不再提供“批量打开文件”，避免一次误开大量文件。
- **文本选择范围收紧**：桌面端默认不可选中文字，仅任务详情抽屉与输入框、文本域、下拉框、可编辑区域保留选择能力；任务详情同时移除 GID 复制按钮。

---

**完整变更对比**：https://github.com/Young-ZJ66/Aria2Desktop/compare/v1.5.0...v1.5.1

# v1.5.1 Release Notes

## 🛠 Fixes

- **Daily labels on the download trend chart**: every bar now has its own date label. The 7-day view shows `MM/DD`; the 30-day view shows the day number, with the month shown on the first day and on the 1st of each month, instead of labelling only the first, middle and last bars.
- **Sidebar navigation can no longer be dragged out**: long-pressing and dragging a sidebar item no longer drags out its link or a translucent drag preview; clicking still navigates as before.
- **Clearer task-detail actions**: the bottom “Open location / Open file” text buttons are removed in favour of the icon buttons beside the file path; Open file now uses a document icon, and the two icons follow the same order as on the completed page.
- **Batch open removed from the completed page**: the batch action bar no longer offers “Open files”, preventing a large number of files from being opened by accident.
- **Text selection limited**: text is no longer selectable by default on desktop; selection remains available in the task-detail drawer and in inputs, textareas, selects and editable areas. The GID copy button in task details is also removed.

---

**Full changelog**: https://github.com/Young-ZJ66/Aria2Desktop/compare/v1.5.0...v1.5.1
